metadata.description: Twelve first-party-reviewed institutions missing from the shared built-in registry at research time. Replace/append JSON records without code edits; --check validates schema, recorded evidence and known identity/listing collisions.
limitations: First-party browsing verifies identity, institutional country, mandate and official news/publication URL only. No news parser or article extraction is validated; every entry is directory_only and searchable=false.
This is a partial EU27 inventory, not a complete network or production coverage assessment. Topic assignments record documented relevance, not a finding of statutory responsibility.
Language is the reviewed listing interface; individual articles may use other languages. Full local names are institutional names; English names can be translations.
Directory discovery fetches only predeclared HTTPS official directory pages and robots rules. Candidate-domain declarations bound EU27 country scope but do not verify candidates' identity or mandate.
JRC country directory entries are historical self-reported survey data. Their external links can be stale or commercial: candidate output remains unverified and is never automatically enrolled.
Reports, candidates and live discovery failures are written separately. Registry responsibility-owner and consistency checks belong to another workflow.
